responseMessageContents.text:
Authorization noted. I still need the actual repository attached to this workspace—your authorization cannot create that connection from chat.

In Rork, use **Project → Connect/Import GitHub**, select **`ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform`**, and approve repository write + Actions permissions. Do not paste credentials here.

When its files appear in this workspace, reply **“repo connected”** and I’ll execute the fix.
